verdicts.reason: Both candidates are close to identical, and both break the design the same way. The headline has been pulled out of its search bar, so the white search bar now sits empty and meaningless at the top. The CTA button's text is too small to read, the 'Д.' in the 'ОНЛАЙН-КУРС Д. СИЛАНТЬЕВА' line is left alone on its own line, and the laptops, glasses and black ring are cropped into unrecognisable scraps (a half ring and a black blob at the bottom). B wins by a very small margin because its search bar sits lower with a little more top margin, while A's is jammed almost against the top edge.
